title: Singing in the band
summary: Penn says he sang with bands because no one else did, and still sings along to Kid Thomas's numbers.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: We were talking about your singing. You say you used to sing all sorts of numbers. They

didn't carry a songster with you. Yeah, well I had to sing those days, Mr. Bill, because we had nobody to sing. And some of the numbers that Thomas thinks of and play, well I'll sing to them yet. I used to like to sing in a band. And I used to study all the-
